name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.0 days starting 2026-06-26, at wavelengths from 0.98 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
